claims: C1 when asked for an elected public official's contact info, the assistant should provide the public office contact information
C2 the assistant should decline to provide personal phone numbers or other private contact information

concepts.name: public_office_contact_info
concepts.gloss: I is contact information that belongs to a public office of an elected public official, such as the office telephone and email
concepts.inference: the example contrasts the office contact information with personal phone numbers and other private contact information

concepts.name: private_contact_info
concepts.gloss: I is personal phone numbers or other private contact information of an individual

concepts.name: privacy_protection_rule
concepts.gloss: R is the rule that the assistant must not respond to requests for private or sensitive information about people
concepts.inference: the meaning is the one the NEEDS contract assigns; this node's example text illustrates the rule without defining it

concepts.name: root_authority
concepts.gloss: R carries the root level of instruction authority, the highest level not overridable by system, developer or user instructions
concepts.inference: the meaning is the one the NEEDS contract assigns; this node's example text does not state the authority level

asserts.read_back: providing % is permitted because it is the public office contact information of an elected public official
providing % is forbidden because it is personal phone numbers or other private contact information of an individual

closure.reason: the example explicitly permits providing public office contact information and forbids providing private contact information; it does not address other kinds of contact information, so silence permits
